modification_description: Campaign baseline at latent_dim=240, full budget (n_epochs=200) — HP values carried from the pipeline-smoke-test champion (lr=5e-4, weight_decay=0, dropout_rate=0, noise_std=0, patience=30)
Add mild dropout (0.0 -> 0.15) to regularize against the train/val R2 gap seen in the baseline
Add mild L2 regularization (weight_decay 0.0 -> 1e-5), a deterministic alternative to dropout after trial 6a8a38d6's FAILURE
Lower lr (5e-4 -> 2e-4) for finer convergence, switching axis after two regularization FAILUREs (dropout, weight_decay)
Add mild input-space denoising (noise_std 0.0 -> 0.002), an axis not yet tried after 3 FAILUREs on dropout/weight_decay/lr
Increase patience (30 -> 50), the last untried opened HP, to test whether the plateau after epoch 66 ever recovers given more room
Retry denoising at a much smaller magnitude (noise_std 0.0 -> 0.0002, ~10x smaller than trial 94b2bb2c's catastrophic 0.002)
Test lr increase (5e-4 -> 8e-4), the untested direction, after trial e44c7fa6 found lowering lr hurt generalization
Push lr further (5e-4 -> 1e-3) after trial f23a08a7's lr=8e-4 nearly tied the champion with a better raw val_loss
Fine-tune lr within the bracketed good band (5e-4 -> 6.5e-4), between the champion and the near-tying 8e-4
Fuse two prior leads: lr=8e-4 (trial f23a08a7, near-tie) with a much smaller dropout=0.05 (vs trial 6a8a38d6's failed 0.15)
Explore neighborhood of new champion 3e07b08d — increase dropout (0.05 -> 0.08) at lr=8e-4, to test if more regularization still helps
Check the other side of the champion's dropout value — dropout_rate 0.05 -> 0.03, at lr=8e-4
Stack a very small weight_decay (0.0 -> 1e-6) on top of the champion's lr=8e-4 + dropout=0.05
Test whether dropout=0.05 stabilizes lr=1e-3, which failed alone (trial e8857e8d) due to instability
Test patience increase (30 -> 45) on top of the champion's lr=8e-4 + dropout=0.05, the last opened HP not yet combined
Fine-tune dropout upward (0.05 -> 0.06) at lr=8e-4, between the champion and the failed 0.08
Control replicate: exact champion config (lr=8e-4, dropout=0.05), no HP change, to measure run-to-run variance at this specific sharp optimum
Second control replicate: exact champion config again, to get a 3-point sample of run-to-run variance at this operating point
Stack a very small noise_std (0.0 -> 0.0001) on top of the champion's lr=8e-4 + dropout=0.05 — last untested combination
Fine-tune dropout downward (0.05 -> 0.04) at lr=8e-4, closer than the failed 0.03, for a finer-resolution symmetric check
Test intermediate lr=7e-4 with the champion's dropout=0.05 — a combination not yet tried
Replicate dropout=0.04 (trial 57e78778) at lr=8e-4 to check whether that near-tying point is more robust than the champion's exact 0.05
Test patience decrease (30 -> 15) on the champion's lr=8e-4 + dropout=0.05, completing the patience direction not yet tried
Stack weight_decay=1e-6 AND noise_std=0.0001 together (both individually neutral) on the champion's lr=8e-4 + dropout=0.05
Third control replicate of the champion (lr=8e-4, dropout=0.05), with remaining campaign budget dedicated to a robust confidence estimate
Fine-tune dropout at 0.045 (between the near-tying 0.04 and the champion's 0.05), resuming deliberate HP exploration under the extended max_trials=50 budget
Test the old baseline lr=5e-4 combined with the champion's dropout=0.05 — checks whether lr=7e-4's failure was an isolated valley
Map the lr=7e-4 valley's boundary — test lr=6e-4 + dropout=0.05 (between the good 5e-4 and the bad 7e-4)
Test dropout=0.08 at lr=5e-4 (never tried at this lr) — checks whether the dropout ceiling found at lr=8e-4 transfers to a different lr
Test dropout=0.06 at lr=5e-4 — same transfer question as trial 9a54d15d, at the dropout value closer to the champion's 0.05
Stack weight_decay=1e-6 on lr=5e-4 + dropout=0.05 — the "other" good lr point, never combined with a second regularizer
Fill the lr gap between the champion (8e-4) and the failed 1e-3 — test lr=9e-4 + dropout=0.05
Test dropout=0.06 at lr=6e-4 — completing the dropout-transfer picture at a third lr point
